faq.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to know about PatentFlow.

items.question: Is PatentFlow a replacement for a patent attorney?
items.answer: PatentFlow is a document preparation and filing assistance tool. While it handles most of the drafting and filing process, we recommend consulting a registered patent attorney for complex inventions or when significant commercial value is at stake.

items.question: What types of patents does PatentFlow support?
items.answer: PatentFlow supports Utility Patents, Design Patents, and Provisional Applications. We guide you through the correct workflow based on your invention type.

items.question: How accurate is the AI-generated patent draft?
items.answer: Our AI generates USPTO-compliant drafts with proper legal terminology and structure. Each draft undergoes automated compliance checking against 37 CFR Part 1 and MPEP requirements.

items.question: Can I file directly with the USPTO through PatentFlow?
items.answer: Yes! PatentFlow integrates directly with USPTO Patent Center for electronic filing. We handle document assembly, format validation, and fee calculation.

items.question: How much can I really save compared to a law firm?
items.answer: Law firms typically charge $8,000-$25,000+ for utility patents. With PatentFlow, total costs (including USPTO fees) typically range from $1,500-$3,000, representing 70-85% savings.

items.question: Is my invention data secure?
items.answer: Absolutely. All data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). We use row-level security, per-user data isolation, and are pursuing SOC 2 Type II certification.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At PatentFlow, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform. Please read this policy carefully. By using PatentFlow, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.content: We collect information you provide directly to us, including: personal information (name, email address, phone number), account credentials, payment information processed securely through our payment provider, invention disclosures and patent application content, usage data and interaction logs, device information and IP addresses, and cookies and similar tracking technologies.

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.content: We use the information we collect to: provide, maintain, and improve our services, process patent applications and filings, communicate with you about your account and applications, send you technical notices and support messages, comply with legal obligations including USPTO filing requirements, detect and prevent fraud and abuse, and conduct research and analytics to improve our platform.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information. All data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 encryption and in transit using TLS 1.3. We employ row-level security, per-user data isolation, and regular security audits. We are pursuing SOC 2 Type II certification to further demonstrate our commitment to security.

cookies.title: Cookies & Tracking Technologies
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect and track information and to improve our service. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, some features of our service may not function properly without cookies. We use essential cookies for authentication and security, analytics cookies to understand usage patterns, and preference cookies to remember your settings.

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParties.content: We may share your information with third-party service providers who perform services on our behalf, including payment processing (Stripe), cloud hosting (AWS/Vercel), analytics (Google Analytics), email communications, and USPTO electronic filing services. These providers are contractually obligated to protect your information and use it only for the purposes we specify.

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.content: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data: the right to access your personal information, the right to correct inaccurate data, the right to delete your data (subject to legal retention requirements), the right to data portability, the right to opt out of marketing communications, and the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. For California residents, additional rights under CCPA apply. For EU/EEA residents, GDPR rights are fully supported.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services. Patent-related documents may be retained longer to comply with legal requirements and USPTO regulations. You may request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting our support team, subject to legal retention obligations.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.content: Our service is not directed to individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that a child has provided us with personal information, we will take steps to delete such information.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Changes are effective when they are posted on this page.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at privacy@patentflow.com or through our Help Center. For data protection inquiries in the EU, you may contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@patentflow.com.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: PatentFlow is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We are continually improving the user experience for everyone and applying the relevant accessibility standards to ensure we provide equal access to all users.

commitment.title: Our Commitment
commitment.content: We believe that the internet should be accessible to all people, regardless of ability or disability. PatentFlow is committed to providing a website and platform that is accessible to the widest possible audience. We actively work to increase the accessibility and usability of our platform and strive to adhere to accepted guidelines and standards.

standards.title: Conformance Standards
standards.content: PatentFlow strives to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA. These guidelines explain how to make web content more accessible for people with disabilities and more user-friendly for everyone. We also comply with Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) requirements for digital accessibility.

features.title: Accessibility Features
features.content: Our platform includes the following accessibility features: full keyboard navigation support throughout the application, proper heading structure and semantic HTML markup, ARIA labels and roles for interactive elements, sufficient color contrast ratios meeting WCAG AA standards, resizable text without loss of content or functionality, alternative text for all meaningful images, focus indicators for keyboard users, skip navigation links, form labels and error messages associated with their controls, and support for both left-to-right (English) and right-to-left (Hebrew) text directions.

assistiveTech.title: Assistive Technology Support
assistiveTech.content: PatentFlow is designed to be compatible with the following assistive technologies: screen readers (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack), screen magnification software, speech recognition software, and keyboard-only navigation. We regularly test our platform with these technologies to ensure compatibility.

knownLimitations.title: Known Limitations
knownLimitations.content: While we strive for full accessibility, some areas of our platform may have limitations: certain complex patent diagrams may not be fully described by alternative text, some third-party embedded content may not meet all accessibility standards, and PDF documents generated by the platform are being improved for screen reader compatibility. We are actively working to address these limitations.

feedback.title: Feedback & Contact
feedback.content: We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of PatentFlow. If you encounter accessibility barriers or have suggestions for improvement, please contact us at accessibility@patentflow.com or through our Help Center. We aim to respond to accessibility feedback within 2 business days and to resolve issues within 10 business days.

enforcement.title: Enforcement & Compliance
enforcement.content: This statement was last reviewed and updated on the date indicated above. We regularly review our accessibility practices and conduct periodic audits using both automated tools and manual testing. If you are not satisfied with our response to your accessibility concern, you may escalate the issue through the appropriate enforcement channels in your jurisdiction.
